verses.saheeh: By the sun and its brightness
verses.khattab: By the sun and its brightness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the sun and her morning light,
verses.romanUrdu: Suraj aur uski dhoop ki kasam

verses.saheeh: And [by] the moon when it follows it
verses.khattab: and the moon as it follows it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the moon when it follows her, rising after she has set,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Chand ki kasam jabke wo uske pichey aata hai

verses.saheeh: And [by] the day when it displays it
verses.khattab: and the day as it unveils it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the day when it reveals her, as it rises [high],
verses.romanUrdu: Aur din ki kasam jabke woh (Suraj ko) numaya kar deta hai

verses.saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers it
verses.khattab: and the night as it conceals it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the night when it enshrouds her, covering her up with its darkness (idhā, ‘when’, in all three instances is an absolute adverbial, operated by the verbal action of the oath).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur raat ki kasam jabke woh (suraj ko) dhank leti hai

verses.saheeh: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
verses.khattab: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the heaven and the One Who built it,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aasman ki aur us zaat ki kasam jisne usey qayam kiya

verses.saheeh: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
verses.khattab: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the earth and the One Who spread it, laid out flat.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zameen ki aur us zaat ki kasam jisne usey bichaya

verses.saheeh: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
verses.khattab: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the soul, that is to say, [by] all souls, and the One Who proportioned it, in its created form (mā in all three instances relates to the verbal action, or functions as man, ‘the one who’),
verses.romanUrdu: Aur nafs-e-Insani ki aur us zaat ki kasam jisne usey hamwar kiya

verses.saheeh: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
verses.khattab: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and inspired to discern its vices and piety, He pointed out to it the path of good and that of evil (the placing of taqwā, ‘piety’, second takes into account the [rhyme] endings of the verses; the response to the oath is [the following:])
verses.romanUrdu: Phir uski badi aur uski parhezgari uss par ilham kar di

verses.saheeh: He has succeeded who purifies it,
verses.khattab: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Successful indeed (qad: the lām [of laqad, ‘indeed’] has been omitted from it for the sake of brevity) will be the one who purifies it, purges it of sins,
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan falah pa gaya woh jisne nafs ka tazkiya kiya

verses.saheeh: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
verses.khattab: and doomed is the one who corrupts it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and he will indeed have failed he who eclipses it, he who obscures it with [acts of] disobedience (dassāhā is actually dassasahā, but the second sīn has been replaced with an alif for [phonetic] ease).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur na-murad hua woh jisne usko daba diya

verses.saheeh: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
verses.khattab: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thamūd denied, their messenger Sālih, because of their rebellious nature,
verses.romanUrdu: Samood ne apni sarkashi ki bina par jhutlaya

verses.saheeh: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
verses.khattab: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when the most wretched of them, whose name was Qudār, was dispatched, [when] he hastened, in order to hamstring the she-camel with their approval.
verses.romanUrdu: Jab us qaum ka sab se zyada shaqi (Badnaseeb) aadmi biphar kar utha

verses.uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
verses.indopak: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ نَاقَةَ اللّٰهِ وَسُقۡيٰهَا ؕ
verses.transliteration: faq<u>a</u>la lahum rasoolu all<u>a</u>hi n<u>a</u>qata all<u>a</u>hi wasuqy<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
verses.khattab: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But then the messenger of God, Sālih, said to them, ‘[This is] the she-camel of God, so let her have her drink!’, her drink on her day — one day was hers, the next theirs.
verses.romanUrdu: To Allah ke Rasool ne un logon se kaha ke khabardar Allah ki ountni (she-camel) ko (haath na lagana) aur uske paani peene (mein maane na hona)

verses.uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.indopak: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَعَقَرُوۡهَا ۙ فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ بِذَنۡۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوّٰٮهَا ۙ
verses.transliteration: faka<u>thth</u>aboohu fa'aqarooh<u>a</u> fadamdama 'alayhim rabbuhum bi<u>th</u>anbihim fasaww<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.khattab: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they denied him, with regard to his saying this [as being a command] from God — which if they contravened would immediately result in chastisement being sent down on them — then hamstrung her, they slew it in order to appropriate her [share of the] drinking water. So their Lord closed in on them, the chastisement, because of their sin, and meted it equally [among them], that is, the closing in on them, in other words, He subsumed them all by it, so that not one of them escaped.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar unhon ne uski baat ko jhuta qarar diya aur ountni ko maar dala. Aakhir-e-kaar unke gunah ke padash mein unke Rubb ne unpar aisi aafat toodi ke ek saath sab ko paywand-e-khaaq kar diya

verses.saheeh: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
verses.khattab: He has no fear of consequences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And He does not (read wa-lā, or fa-lā) fear the consequence of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usey (apne is fail kay) kisi burey natije ka koi khauf(darr) nahin hai
